column1: # phase 5 KQL library. Single-line code only (loader is line-based).
# KQL string literals use single quotes on purpose: valid KQL

column5: code
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where ResultType != '0' | summarize count() by ResultType | order by count_ desc
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where ClientAppUsed in ('POP3','IMAP4','SMTP','Exchange ActiveSync','Other clients') | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('medium','high') | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, IPAddress, AppDisplayName
Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where IsBillable == true | summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024, 2) by DataType | order by GB desc
SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where Status != 'Success' | summarize count() by SentinelResourceName, Status
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Operation in ('New-InboxRule','Set-InboxRule') | project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, Parameters
DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType startswith 'Asr' | summarize count() by ActionType | order by count_ desc
EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType has 'ZAP' | project Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, ActionType, DeliveryLocation
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where ConditionalAccessStatus == 'failure' | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName | order by count_ desc
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where ResultType == '0' and AuthenticationRequirement == 'singleFactorAuthentication' | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName | order by count_ desc

SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where ResultType == '0' | summarize Countries = dcount(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)), Sample = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 5) by UserPrincipalName | where Countries > 1
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where UserType == 'Guest' | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName
SigninLogs | where UserPrincipalName in ('bg1@contoso.com','bg2@contoso.com') | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType
AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where OperationName in ('Add member to role','Remove member from role') | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatedBy, TargetResources
AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where OperationName has 'Consent to application' | project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy, TargetResources
AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where OperationName in ('Add user','Delete user') | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatedBy
AADRiskyUsers | where RiskState == 'atRisk' | project UserPrincipalName, RiskLevel, RiskLastUpdatedDateTime
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where ResultType != '0' | summarize count() by ServicePrincipalName, ResultType
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where Operation == 'Set-Mailbox' and Parameters has 'Forwarding' | project TimeGenerated, UserId, Parameters
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Operation == 'FileDownloaded' | summarize Files = count() by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | where Files > 100
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Operation in ('AnonymousLinkCreated','SharingSet') | project TimeGenerated, UserId, OfficeObjectId, Operation
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where Operation in ('Add-MailboxPermission','Add-RecipientPermission') | project TimeGenerated, UserId, Parameters
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecordType == 'ExchangeAdmin' | summarize count() by Operation | top 20 by count_
DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where FileName in ('certutil.exe','mshta.exe','regsvr32.exe','rundll32.exe','bitsadmin.exe') | summarize count() by FileName, DeviceName

DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where FileName =~ 'powershell.exe' and ProcessCommandLine has_any (' -enc ', '-encodedcommand') | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType == 'UsbDriveMounted' | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AdditionalFields
DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(14d) | where ActionType contains 'Tamper' | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType
DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType == 'InboundConnectionAccepted' and LocalPort == 3389 | summarize count() by DeviceName, RemoteIP

DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(14d) | where ActionType == 'UserAccountAddedToLocalGroup' and AdditionalFields has 'S-1-5-32-544' | project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, AdditionalFields
DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType == 'AntivirusDetection' | summarize count() by FileName, DeviceName | order by count_ desc
DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId | where Timestamp < ago(7d) | project DeviceName, Timestamp, OSPlatform
DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | where ActionType == 'FirewallInboundConnectionBlocked' | summarize count() by RemoteIP | top 20 by count_

column2: Bulk file renames per device (1h bins)
column5: DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | where ActionType == 'FileRenamed' | summarize Renames = count() by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 1h) | where Renames > 500
EmailEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ThreatTypes has 'Phish' and DeliveryLocation == 'Inbox/folder' | project Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, SenderFromAddress
EmailEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | where ThreatTypes has_any ('Phish','Malware') | summarize count() by RecipientEmailAddress | top 10 by count_
UrlClickEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType != 'ClickAllowed' | project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, ActionType, IsClickedThrough
EmailEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where DetectionMethods has 'Spoof' | summarize count() by SenderFromDomain | top 15 by count_
EmailAttachmentInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize count() by FileType | top 15 by count_
CloudAppEvents | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | where ActionType has 'Delete' | summarize Deletes = count() by AccountDisplayName, bin(Timestamp, 1h) | where Deletes > 50
IdentityQueryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize count() by QueryType | order by count_ desc
Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where IsBillable == true | summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024, 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated asc
SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where SentinelResourceType == 'Analytics Rule' and Status != 'Success' | summarize count() by SentinelResourceName
SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where SentinelResourceType has 'Automation' and Status != 'Success' | project TimeGenerated, SentinelResourceName, Description

SecurityIncident | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where Status == 'Closed' and CreatedTime > ago(30d) | extend Hours = datetime_diff('hour', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) | summarize AvgHours = avg(Hours), Incidents = count()
SecurityIncident | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where Status != 'Closed' | summarize count() by Severity
SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize count() by ProductName | order by count_ desc
Usage | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DataType | order by LastSeen asc
_GetWatchlist('vips') | join kind=inner (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)) on $left.SearchKey == $right.UserPrincipalName | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where OperationNameValue endswith 'DELETE' | summarize count() by Caller, OperationNameValue
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where OperationNameValue has 'networksecuritygroups' and OperationNameValue endswith 'write' | project TimeGenerated, Caller, Properties
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where OperationNameValue has 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and OperationNameValue endswith 'write' | project TimeGenerated, Caller, Resource
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where OperationNameValue has 'roleassignments' and OperationNameValue endswith 'write' | project TimeGenerated, Caller, Properties
Heartbeat | summarize LastBeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | where LastBeat < ago(1h) | order by LastBeat asc
Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize Computers = dcount(Computer) by Version | order by Computers desc
WVDErrors | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize count() by CodeSymbolic | top 10 by count_
WVDConnections | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where State == 'Connected' | summarize count() by SessionHostName
IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId | where ComplianceState != 'Compliant' | project DeviceName, OS, ComplianceState, UserName
IntuneOperationalLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where OperationName has 'Enrollment' and Result != 'Success' | project TimeGenerated, Identity, Result, FailureReason
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where RecordType has 'Discovery' | project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation
OfficeActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where Operation has 'DlpRuleMatch' | summarize count() by Operation, UserId
